identity_anchor.matching_rule: atomic_number and symbol must both match the local IUPAC identity seed

ownership.role: external media reference projection; no media binary copied

selection_policy: Anchor identity to the local IUPAC 1..118 seed; discard Wikidata rows whose symbol does not match that atomic number; among remaining entities prefer one with P18 and then lowest numeric Q-id; preserve Commons per-file licensing metadata.

wikidata.role: P18 image reference resolved only after IUPAC identity match

wikimedia_commons.role: image URL and per-file license/artist/credit metadata
